mentions.name: Isabilaw
mentions.description: A legal AI operating system for West Africa, launched for Nigeria as a chatbot MVP. It plans to spin off into two product offerings that solve legal and compliance issues in West Africa.
mentions.problem: Legal and compliance issues in West Africa.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am working on a Leal AI OS for West Africa called Isabilaw.com

At the moment it is launched for Nigeria, as a chatbot for the MVP. - www.isabilaw.com

It will spin off to two product offering that will solve Legal and Compliance issues in West Africa
